description: Alterations to the rear & side fenestration and associated landscaping, minor reconfiguration of the Lower Ground Floor, and replacement of the existing single glazed window panes with new slimline double glazed units installed within the original timber frames. Original window frames to be repaired wherever possible, new timber frames installed to match existing profiles where repair is not viable.
decision_conditions:
All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the adjacent work with regard to the methods used and to material, colour, texture and profile. Please condition that all proposed windows are to be timber framed with white painted timber, as well as white internal spacers and white beading. Please also condition that the exact same brickwork as the existing is utilised when converting the existing side elevation door to a window. Also please condition that any stone headers introduced match the brick of the existing stone headers exactly. 
REASON: In order to safeguard the special architectural or historic interest of the building.
